name: Kimi Code
description: Runs Moonshot's Kimi coding agent in the terminal, a desktop app, or VS Code to read and edit code and run commands, with MCP, skills, subagents, hooks, and ACP editor support.

skills.name: MCP Configuration
skills.description: Adds, edits, and authenticates MCP servers conversationally with /mcp-config.

skills.name: Agent Skills and Plugins
skills.description: Installs skills, MCP servers, and data sources from the marketplace or a GitHub repo.

skills.name: Subagents
skills.description: Dispatches built-in coder, explore, and plan subagents in isolated contexts.

skills.name: Lifecycle Hooks
skills.description: Runs local commands at key points to gate risky tool calls or trigger notifications.

skills.name: Editor Integration (ACP)
skills.description: Lets Zed, JetBrains, and other Agent Client Protocol clients drive a session via kimi acp.
